text: dsh-agora 是面向 DSH Web 配置的 Agora 技能包，通过 Cordis 的 skills 服务注册名为 agora 的技能，并从随包资源读取技能正文。它为构建语音 AI、RTC 音视频与直播、RTM 消息和录制等 Agora 应用提供自然语言入口，也包含面向中国大陆部署的区域差异资料。需要 DSH；实际构建 Agora 应用时需自行准备相应 Agora 账户与凭据。

dsh-agora registers an Agora skill with DSH and loads its bundled body. It guides natural-language work on voice AI, RTC calls and streaming, RTM messaging, recording, and mainland China deployment. DSH is required; building a real Agora app requires an Agora account and credentials.
我想用自然语言规划一个基于 Agora 的语音 AI 助手。
帮我找到搭建实时音视频通话或直播应用的 Agora 指引。
I need guidance for adding Agora in-app messaging and presence to an app.
dsh-agora 的功能「Agora 技能入口」：在 DSH 的 skills 服务注册 agora 技能；当用户提出语音 AI、音视频、消息或录制等 Agora 集成需求时，可调用该技能内容。
dsh-agora 的功能「区域部署资料」：打包时为 Agora 产品参考资料加入中国大陆区域差异文件和区域确认提示，供技能在处理区域部署问题时参考。
dsh-agora 在打包同步阶段会从 GitHub 获取 AgoraIO/skills 发布包；这发生在 prepack 同步流程中。
dsh-agora 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 83 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-agora README · dsh-agora：**A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds the official Agora skill — with Shengwang support baked in — to your agent.** One install gives you voice AI agents, RTC video/voice calls, RTM chat & signaling, Cloud Recording, Agora CLI acceleration, and server-side token generation — driven from natural language.

The skill is synced verbatim from the official [AgoraIO/skills](https://github.com/AgoraIO/skills) repository, so it always matches the Agora docs and quickstarts.

dsh-agora README · Prerequisites：- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) installed and running
- An [Agora](https://console.agora.io) account (for tokens/App ID when you build a real app)

dsh-agora README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agora
```

> **Note**: with pnpm ≥ 8.15 (e.g. 9.15) the profile workspace root rejects a
> bare `add` with `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`. If you hit that, pass `-w`:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-agora
> ```

Restart the web profile, and the `agora` skill appears in the skill catalog.

dsh-agora README · What the skill covers：| Area | What you can do |
|---|---|
| **Voice AI agents** (ConvoAI) | Build voice agents / voicebots |
| **RTC** | Video & voice calls, live streaming, screen sharing |
| **RTM** | Chat, presence, signaling |
| **Cloud Recording** | Record calls and streams |
| **Server** | Generate tokens & App IDs server-side |
| **Server Gateway** | Cross-product server coordination |
| **Agora CLI** | CLI acceleration (auto-detected if installed) |

dsh-agora README · Shengwang support：The same `agora` skill covers the Shengwang region (`console.shengwang.cn`). At release time, the plugin injects a **region gate** at the top of each product reference — the model confirms China vs global first — and ships a per-product CN difference map (`cn.md`) that the model loads only when the user targets mainland China:

dsh-agora README · Shengwang support：| Product | CN delta |
|---|---|
| RTC | CN region (`setArea({ areaCode: "CHINA" })` / `AREA_CODE_CN`) + `sd-rtn.com` + cloud proxy |
| RTM | CN region (`setArea({ areaCodes: ["CHINA"] })` / `RtmAreaCode.CN`) + CN data center |
| Cloud Recording | `api.sd-rtn.com` + `clientRequest.region="CN"` + mainland storage |
| Server (token) | token algorithm unchanged; CN REST domain + credential menu path |
| Agora CLI | `agora project create --region cn` / `--rtm-data-center CN` |
| ConvoAI | English quickstart skeleton + `api.agora.io/cn` endpoint + BYOK vendors (`fengming` ASR, `deepseek`/`minimax` LLM/TTS) |

dsh-agora README · Shengwang support：The official skill content stays verbatim; the region gate and CN maps are generated at build time (see `scripts/sync-deps.sh`), so there is still a single `agora` skill — no separate companion skill.

dsh-agora README · Using the skill：Describe what you want in natural language — e.g. *"set up a voice AI agent with Agora"* or *"build an RTC video call app"*. The skill routes to the official quickstarts and guides you through setup, including auth and token flows.

dsh-agora README · FAQ：**Does this repo contain the skill itself?** The official `agora` content is synced verbatim from the AgoraIO/skills repo at each release (not committed). The Shengwang deltas live in `assets/agora-cn/` and are built at release time into a per-product `cn.md` map plus a region gate (see `scripts/sync-deps.sh`).

**Do I need the Agora CLI installed?** No. It's optional; if it's on your `PATH`, the skill uses it for faster workflows.
